about:
S.A.Y. Plastics Inc. operates a custom injection molding facility in Jacksonville, Texas. The company has been in business for over 30 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been released.

The plant spans more than 220,000 square feet of production and warehousing space and runs 41 injection molding presses ranging from 75 to 2,000 tons of clamping force. The company processes engineering resins such as ABS, PVC, nylon, polycarbonate, and PPS, along with commodity resins including polyethylene, polypropylene, and polystyrene. Secondary operations cover solvent welding, hot stamping, image transfer, secondary machining, assembly, special packaging, and distribution, plus support for new mold creation and mold modifications. The workforce numbers approximately 150 employees.

S.A.Y. Plastics supplies molded components to the pet products, plumbing, HVAC, and automotive sectors. Customers include manufacturers in those industries who require custom injection molded parts and value-added assembly.

The company states its mission is to provide products and services that meet or exceed customer requirements for performance, reliability, and safety at a competitive cost.
